podcast.title: Early Gigs (2008-2009)
podcast.body: Fitz and The Tantrums began playing gigs at the end of 2008, continuing through 2009, and by the end of 2009, they were opening shows for Maroon 5. "Bigs began at the end of 2008 and continued through the next 12 months. A debut EP was recorded in early 2009, and by the end of the year, they were opening shows for Maroon 5."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Breakthrough at 41 (2011)
xref.body: Michael Fitzpatrick, known as "Fitz" of Fitz and The Tantrums, achieved his first major hit single in 2011 with "MoneyGrabber" when he was 41 years old. "When this became the band's first breakthrough single in 2011, Michael was 41 years old."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Co-Lead Singer of Fitz and The Tantrums
xref.body: Noelle Scaggs has been the co-lead singer of Fitz and The Tantrums since 2010. "Noiles Skakes is the co-lead singer of Fits and the Tantrums. She's been a member of the group since 2010."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Co-founder of Diversify The Stage
xref.body: Noelle Scaggs, co-leader of Fitz and The Tantrums, founded Diversify The Stage. This organization is committed to expanding opportunities for women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and female-identifying and gender non-conforming individuals within the music industry. "Noile Skakes, the co-leader of Fits and the Tantrums, founded a group called Diversified the Stage, which is dedicated to opening up new opportunities for women, people of color, LGBTQ people, and female identifying and gender non-conforming individuals."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
